contentList.content: Wizards can learn new Spells by transcribing Spell scrolls to their Spellbook in exchange for gold. Scrolls are destroyed once transcribed.

You gain one Arcane Recovery point per level, which are restored upon taking a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>. Arcane Recovery points allow you to recover <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag>.
Utilized to recover <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag> through <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ArcaneRecovery">Arcane Channeling</LSTag>.
Use your knowledge of the Weave around you in order to replenish your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag>.
Spend 1 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charge in order to acquire a level one <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Spend 2 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charges in order to acquire a level two <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Spend 3 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charges in order to acquire a level three <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Spend 4 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charges in order to acquire a level four <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Spend 5 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charges in order to acquire a level five <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Spend 6 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charges in order to acquire a level six <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Upon casting a Spell, restore one of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charges.
Upon fulfilling your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Scholarly_Acumen">Scholarly Acumen</LSTag>, a new Acumen is immediately rolled for.

Once per turn, upon fulfilling your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Scholarly_Acumen">Scholarly Acumen</LSTag>, the next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> you make with a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> will automatically roll as a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.

Affected creature will roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> upon making an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> with a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag>.
Once per turn, you may spend 3 charges of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> in order to recover your <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Action</LSTag>.

Spend 3 charges of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> in order to receive an additional <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Action</LSTag> for the rest of your turn.
The cost to learn Transmutation Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.
The cost to learn Conjuration Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.
The cost to learn Divination Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.
The cost to learn Evocation Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.
The cost to learn Necromancy Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.
The cost to learn Illusion Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.
The cost to learn Abjuration Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.
The cost to learn Enchantment Spells from scrolls is reduced by half.

The arcane and swordplay have always gone hand in hand for you. Over time, you have become a vertiable storm of steel and magic alike.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

In combat, you may siphon the Arcane energy from the fallen. Doing so restores charges of Arcane Recovery and infuses your weapons with Arcane Force.

In addition, you also gain Steel-Wind Strike.

Siphon Arcane energy from the nearby fallen, restoring charges of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> and infusing your weapons with <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ARCANE_FORCE">Arcane Force</LSTag>.

Affected weapon deals an additional [1]. In addition, it's wielder's <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage.

Teleport to a nearby creature in the blink of an eye and strike them with your equipped weapon. Afterwards, a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CLOAKOFDAGGERS">Cloak of Daggers</LSTag> is created under your target for three turns. The strength of your Cloak of Daggers changes depending on the level of <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> spent.
Deals [1] to all enemies within the cloak.
Affected creature is taking [1] at the start of each turn.
Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SteelWindStorm">Steel-Wind Storm</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_SteelWindBeam">Steel-Wind Burst</LSTag>.

This action utilizes a weapon based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> while also functioning as a Spell. If a Spell innately deals both physical and elemental damage, the elemental damage cannot be increased.

This action utilizes a weapon based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> while also functioning as a <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag>. If a Cantrip innately deals both physical and elemental damage, the elemental damage cannot be increased.

Invoke the Arcane winds which guide you, granting a +2 bonus to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on all melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.

Affected creature has a +2 bonus to their <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on all melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.
Fire a beam of pure Arcane energy, carrying the properties of your weapon toward a target of your choice. This action cannot miss.
<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CLOAKOFDAGGERS">Cloak of Daggers</LSTag> now causes enemies to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleed</LSTag> for three turns.

Once per turn, upon landing a killing blow, you may cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_SteelWindStrike">Steel-Wind Strike</LSTag> without expending an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag>.
Affected creature may cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_SteelWindStrike">Steel-Wind Strike</LSTag> without expending an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag>.
Upon damaging a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleeding</LSTag> creature with a weapon, you gain a stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLOODSTORMSERRATION">Force Serration</LSTag>.
Affected creature deals an additional [1] with all weapon attacks made against non-allied targets.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="WINDSOFTHEARCBLADE">Winds of the Arcblade</LSTag> is active, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_SteelWindStrike">Steel-Wind Strike</LSTag> will always roll as a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.

Amidst a blend of steel and magic, you twist and harden the Weave into Arcane Wards to protect yourself and others.

Suggested Role(s): Tank

The first Spell you cast each turn charges a magical ward around you. The ward absorbs damage done to you equal to the number of charges remaining, and grants you Resistance to physical damage. When it is reduced to 0 charges remaining, you take the remaining damage. You are also capable of projecting your ward to an ally, reducing the damage they would take.

Casting Spells adds charges to the ward equal to the level of the Spell cast. You may have up to seven ward charges at any given time. While your Arcane Ward is active, you will be considered to be a preferred target.

Affected creature is protected by an Arcane Ward, granting them <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to physical damage. The damage they take is reduced by an amount equal to the number of charges it currently has left. Casting Spells will add charges to the ward equal to the level of the Spell cast, and while the Arcane Ward is active, this creature is considered to be a preferred target.
When a nearby ally is about to take damage and you have an active <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ARCANE_WARD">Arcane Ward</LSTag>, you can utilize your Ward to reduce the damage they take.

When a nearby ally is about to take damage, use your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="ArcaneWard">Arcane Ward</LSTag> to reduce the damage by an amount equal equal to its charges. Afterwards, your Arcane Ward loses 1 charge.
Being damaged deals Force damage to your aggressor equal to the amount of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ARCANE_WARD">Arcane Ward</LSTag> charges you have remaining multiplied by two.
While you have charges of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ARCANE_WARD">Arcane Ward</LSTag> active, you cannot be <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critically Hit</LSTag>.
Dealing damage will charge one stack of your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ARCANE_WARD">Arcane Ward</LSTag>.

Upon gaining a charge of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ARCANE_WARD">Arcane Ward</LSTag>, you deal Force damage to all enemies within [1] of your target equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Intelligence Modifier</LSTag>.
Gain permanent <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="LOCKDOWN_CONDITION">Lockdown Immunity</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to all forms of damage at all times.

The elements answer your call as loyal companions. Whether flame, storm, stone, or tide, each serves as an extension of your arcane mastery.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Summoner
Gain the ability to summon one of four <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SummonElementalContainer">Elementals</LSTag>. Each Elemental scales with your level in Wizard.
Bend the barrier between the Planes until they disgorge an elemental ally to follow and fight for you.
Conjure an air elemental that can <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SHOCKED">Shock</LSTag> your foes. The elemental grows in strength alongside you as you level as an Elementalist.
Conjure an earth elemental that can create sludgy mud surfaces while walloping your foes. The elemental grows in strength alongside you as you level as an Elementalist.
Conjure a fire elemental that can make your foes <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burn</LSTag>. The elemental grows in strength alongside you as you level as an Elementalist.
Conjure a water elemental that can mete out cold punishment upon your foes. The elemental grows in strength alongside you as you level as an Elementalist.
Gales of crackling, stormy wind swirl around you, battering nearby creatures and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SHOCKED">Shocking</LSTag> them.
Bring down your arms like stone slabs, smashing nearby creatures, and potentially pushing them back [1] while knocking them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.
<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FROSTBITE">Frostbitten</LSTag> targets take double damage.
Conjure a healing mist, restoring the <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> of an ally you can see.

Depending on which <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SummonElementalContainer">Elemental</LSTag> you currently have summoned, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> of their respective damage type when targeting an enemy or item.

Depending on which <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SummonElementalContainer">Elemental</LSTag> you currently have summoned, you deal an additional 1d4 damage of their respective type. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon. In addition, each of your elementals have learned a new action.

Depending on which <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SummonElementalContainer">Elemental</LSTag> you currently have summoned, you gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to their respective type of damage.

Depending on which <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SummonElementalContainer">Elemental</LSTag> you currently have summoned, when taking damage of their respective type, you reflect it as Force damage back at your aggressor. In addition, each of your elementals have learned a new action.
You may summon all four <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SummonElementalContainer">Elementals</LSTag> at once.

As an evoker, you stride unharmed through the unfettered chaos you call, a storm of mysicism contained only by the flick of your wrist.

Suggested Role(s): Damage
Create pockets of safety within damaging, area of effect Spells that you directly cast. Allies will take no damage from them.
When casting a Spell that makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, you roll with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

Upon casting a Spell, restore one of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> charges. A <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> must be consumed in order for this effect to trigger.
You add your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Intelligence Modifier</LSTag> to the damage of all Spells you cast when damaging a non-allied target.
When damaging an enemy with a Spell, all enemies within [1] of your target take Force damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Intelligence Modifier</LSTag>.
The first Spell you cast each turn will not cost an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.

A lifetime of study has granted you mastery over the elements. As they manifest, disperse, and converge at your fingertips, each leaves behind a residual stain — malleable, mutable, and awaiting your command.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Support

Upon dealing elemental damage to an enemy with a Spell or Cantrip, you generate one Elemental Stain, dependent on the type of damage dealt.

Elemental Stains empower your Spells and Cantrips in various ways, depending on what types of Elemental Stains you currently possess. This can be toggled at any time.

While active, Elemental Stains will not be generated.

Gain the ability to expend one charge of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> in order to generate an Elemental Stain of your choice. In addition, you may create an elemental surface, teleport to a location you can see, or swap places with an ally as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.
Generate an Elemental Stain of your choice.
Generate an elemental surface of your choice.
Generate a fire surface at an area of your choosing.
Generate an ice surface at an area of your choosing.
Generate a poison surface at an area of your choosing.
Generate a water surface at an area of your choosing.
Generate an electrified water surface at an area of your choosing.
Teleport to an area you can see, or swap places with an ally.
When expending an active Elemental Stain, you have a 50% chance to not consume it.
Gain the ability to expend your Elemental Stains to deal 1d12 damage to an enemy. The amount of and types of damage you deal scales with how many Elemental Stains you currently possess.
Expend all of your Elemental Stains to deal damage to an enemy. The amount of damage you deal scales with how many Elemental Stains you currently possess.
Once per turn, upon generating an Elemental Stain, you potentially generate one Elemental Stain of a random element.

Gain the ability to expend all of your Elemental Stains to deal 1d8 damage to creatures within a [1] area. The amount of and types of damage you deal scales with how many Elemental Stains you currently possess.
Expend all of your Elemental Stains to deal damage to creatures within a [1] area. The amount of damage you deal scales with how many Elemental Stains you currently possess.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will reduce your targets Armour Class by 2 until the end of their next turn.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will halve your targets Movement Speed until the end of their next turn.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will reduce the number required to roll a Critical Hit by 1.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will ignore all forms of damage Resistance when dealing damage to an enemy or item.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will prevent your target from using Reactions until the end of their next turn.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will prevent your target from regaining Hit Points until the end of their next turn.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will impose Disadvantage on your targets Attack Rolls until the end of their next turn.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will impose Disadvantage on your targets Saving Throws until the end of their next turn.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next Spell or Cantrip you cast which targets an ally with will restore their Hit Points. The amount of Hit Points restored scales with your level.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.

The next instance of damage you cause with either a Spell or Cantrip will render your target unable to speak, preventing them from casting Spells with a verbal components until the end of their next turn.

Elemental Concierge must be toggled on in order to utilize this effect.
Affected creature's <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> is reduced by 2 until the end of their next turn.
Affected creature's <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> is halved until the end of their next turn.
Affected creature is unable to utilize <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reactions</LSTag> until the end of their next turn.
Affected creature is unable to regain <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> until the end of their next turn.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> until the end of their next turn.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> until the end of their next turn.
Affected creature has recovered <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>.
Affected creature is unable to speak, preventing them from casting Spells with a verbal component until the end of their next turn.
Touch a creature, infusing them with a concentrated filament of acid.
Launch a razor shard of ice at a creature. If the target has moved this turn, the damage dealt is increased.
Project a searing lance of flame in a line, dealing Fire damage to all creatures in its path.
Release a surge of compressed force in a short cone, dealing Force damage and pushing creatures [1] away from you.
Unleash a crackling bolt of lightning at a creature, dealing Lightning damage. The bolt arcs to a nearby enemy for reduced damage.
Channel necrotic energy through your hand, dealing damage to a creature that you touch. You regain <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> equal to the damage dealt.

Expel virulent toxin around you, dealing damage to creatures within [1] of you and imposing <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> for one turn.

Assault a creature’s mind, shattering their perception of what's nearby. On a failed <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, the target becomes stricken with <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Madness</LSTag> for one turn.
Fire a beam of radiant light at a creature. On a failed <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, the target is <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag> for one turn.
Emit a thunderous pulse around a creature, dealing damage to creatures within [1] of them and pushing them backward by [2].

Amidst depraved conjurations, you walk comfortably within the shadow of death, making your home there in spite of the living.

Suggested Role(s): Summoner

Dealing damage to an enemy will permanently apply <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CRAWLING_GNAW_SWITCH">Crawling Gnaw</LSTag> to your target. No effect when damaging Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Ooze, or Undead. Zombies born from Crawling Gnaw are considered to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SUMMONING_SICKNESS">Horde-Based</LSTag> summons.
When you deal damage with a Spell, you recover <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> equal to half of the total damage dealt.
At the beginning of any combat encounter, all suitable corpses within [1] are raised as Undead.
At the beginning of any combat encounter, you immediately summon a Death Shepherd. In addition, you gain the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BindUndead">Bind Undead</LSTag> creatures.

Bind an Undead creature to magically dominate them. Bound Undead retain all capabilities they had in undeath. <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Dangerous_Encounter">Dangerous</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Fatal_Encounter">Fatal</LSTag> creatures cannot be Bound.
Affected creature has been reanimated by a nearby Necromancer. Their soul is now bound to their new owner.

All allied Undead within [1] gain a bonus to their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage dealt to non-allied targets equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Intelligence Modifier</LSTag> during combat.
Your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ZOMBIE_DECAY">Newborn Zombies</LSTag> now last until the end of combat, rather than for three turns.

At the start of each of your turns during combat, you gain one to three Scholarly Acumen. Scholarly Acumen assign various tasks for you complete in order to further your knowledge of the arcane. Upon completing these tasks, you recover charges of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> minus one.

For completing your assigned study, you have recovered charges of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> minus one.
Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon dealing [1].
Affected creature has regained <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> for free this turn.
Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Transmutation school.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Abjuration school.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Conjuration school.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Divination school.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Enchantment school.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Evocation school.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Illusion school.

Affected creature will regain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneRecoveryPoint">Arcane Recovery</LSTag> upon casting a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> belonging to the Necromancy school.

Amidst the tapestry of magic, you weave as a purveyor of influence.
Within this knowledge, indelible power manifests.

Gain the ability to interrupt any Spell by utilizing your Reaction and an Arcane Recovery.

Fatal creatures cannot have their Spells countered.

Interrupt a Spell from being cast.

Fatal creatures cannot have their Spells countered.
When damaged by a melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, release a shockwave which forces nearby enemies back by [1].
While <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentrating</LSTag>, gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

Emit an aura across [1] granting both you and nearby allies the effects of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FEATHERFALL">Featherfall</LSTag>. If an ally moves out of range of the aura, the effects will persist for one turn.

Affected creature is emitting an aura across [1] granting both themselves and nearby allies the effects of Featherfall, protecting them from all non-lethal fall damage.

If an ally moves out of range of the aura, its effects will persist for one turn.
Affected creature has the effects of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FEATHERFALL">Featherfall</LSTag>, protecting them from all non-lethal fall damage.

After each Long Rest, gain three random Portent Dice. During the day, you can use your Reaction and a charge of your Arcane Recovery to change the die of any Attack Roll or Saving Throw rolled near you to that of one of your Portent Dice.

Each Portent Die can only be used once, and you lose your unused Portent Dice at the end of the day. Upon taking a Short Rest you will receive Prophecies for any spent Portent Dice. Complete these Prophecies to regain them.
Change the die of a nearby <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> to [1]. Bonuses and penalties are still added to the result.

When an enemy fails a <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attack</LSTag> against you, use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> in order to retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShockingGrasp">Shocking Grasp</LSTag>.
When an enemy fails a <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attack</LSTag> against you, retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShockingGrasp">Shocking Grasp</LSTag>.
